queries.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.base_price FROM Product p WHERE p.base_price > 100 AND p.is_active = 1;
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.quantity, p.mv_attributes FROM Product p WHERE p.quantity < 20;
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM Product p WHERE p.base_price IN (25, 50, 100);
SELECT pp.product_name, pp.dimensions FROM PhysicalProduct pp WHERE pp.base_price >= 200;
SELECT dp.product_name, dp.delivery_type FROM DigitalProduct dp WHERE dp.is_active = 1;
SELECT e.product_name, e.warranty_months FROM Electronics e WHERE e.warranty_months >= 12 AND e.base_price > 300;
SELECT c.product_name, c.cpu, c.ram_gb FROM Computer c WHERE c.ram_gb >= 16;
SELECT d.product_name, d.cpu, d.form_factor FROM Desktop d WHERE d.base_price > 500;
SELECT l.product_name, l.ram_gb, l.battery_wh FROM Laptop l WHERE l.battery_wh >= 60;
SELECT t.product_name, t.screen_size_in FROM Tablet t WHERE t.screen_size_in IN (10, 11, 13);
SELECT s.product_name, s.band_size FROM Smartwatch s WHERE s.is_active = 1;
SELECT c.product_name, c.sensor_mp FROM Camera c WHERE c.sensor_mp >= 24;
SELECT p.product_name, p.carrier_lock FROM Phone p WHERE p.carrier_lock = 'unlocked';
SELECT a.product_name, a.accessory_type FROM Accessory a WHERE a.base_price > 100;
SELECT a.product_name, a.energy_rating FROM Appliance a WHERE a.energy_rating IN ('A', 'A+');
SELECT k.product_name, k.energy_rating, k.warranty_years FROM KitchenAppliance k WHERE k.warranty_years >= 2;
SELECT a.product_name, a.size_system FROM Apparel a WHERE a.quantity > 0;
SELECT c.product_name, c.size_system, c.material FROM Clothing c WHERE c.material = 'cotton';
SELECT m.product_name, m.material, m.fit_type_men FROM MenClothing m WHERE m.base_price < 150;
SELECT w.product_name, w.material, w.fit_type_women FROM WomenClothing w WHERE w.is_active = 1;
SELECT f.product_name, f.size_system, f.sole_material FROM Footwear f WHERE f.quantity >= 5;
SELECT m.product_name, m.delivery_type, m.format FROM Media m WHERE m.format IN ('audio', 'video');
SELECT s.product_name, s.delivery_type, s.license_type FROM Software s WHERE s.base_price <= 200;
SELECT u.email, u.mv_user FROM User u WHERE u.password_hash IS NOT NULL;
SELECT c.email, c.loyalty_tier, c.contact_no FROM Customer c WHERE c.loyalty_tier <> 'basic';
SELECT p.email, p.loyalty_tier, p.renewal_date, p.subscription_addons FROM PrimeCustomer p WHERE p.renewal_date IS NOT NULL;
SELECT b.email, b.company_name FROM BusinessCustomer b WHERE b.company_name IS NOT NULL;
SELECT e.email, e.employee_no FROM Employee e WHERE e.employee_no IS NOT NULL;
SELECT c.category_name, c.parent FROM Category c WHERE c.parent IS NOT NULL;
SELECT o.placed_at, o.status FROM CustOrder o WHERE o.status IN ('placed', 'shipped');
SELECT pi.url, pi.alt_text, pi.sort_order FROM ProductImage pi WHERE pi.sort_order <= 3;
SELECT p.product_name, pi.url FROM ProductImage pi JOIN Product p ON OWNER(pi) = REF(p) WHERE p.is_active = 1;
SELECT pv.barcode, pv.price_override, pv.is_active_variant FROM ProductVariant pv WHERE pv.price_override IS NOT NULL;
SELECT p.product_name, pv.barcode, pv.price_override FROM ProductVariant pv JOIN Product p ON OWNER(pv) = REF(p) WHERE pv.is_active_variant = 1;
SELECT ph.starts_at, ph.ends_at, ph.price FROM PriceHistory ph WHERE ph.price > 100;
SELECT p.product_name, ph.starts_at, ph.price FROM PriceHistory ph JOIN Product p ON OWNER(ph) = REF(p) WHERE ph.price < p.base_price;
SELECT a.kind, a.city, a.state, a.country FROM Address a WHERE a.country = 'US';
SELECT c.email, a.kind, a.city, a.postal_code FROM Address a JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(a) = REF(c) WHERE a.state = 'MD';
SELECT pm.brand, pm.last4, pm.exp_month, pm.exp_year FROM PaymentMethod pm WHERE pm.is_default = 'true';
SELECT c.email, pm.brand, pm.last4 FROM PaymentMethod pm JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(pm) = REF(c) WHERE pm.exp_year >= 2027;
SELECT c.updated_at, OWNER(c) AS customer_ref FROM Cart c WHERE c.updated_at IS NOT NULL;
SELECT w.wishlist_name, OWNER(w) AS customer_ref FROM Wishlist w WHERE w.wishlist_name IS NOT NULL;
SELECT r.rating, r.title, r.created_at FROM Review r WHERE r.rating >= 4;
SELECT c.email, r.rating, r.title FROM Review r JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(r) = REF(c) WHERE r.rating <= 2;
SELECT s.started_at, s.device, OWNER(s) AS user_ref FROM BrowsingSession s WHERE s.device IN ('mobile', 'desktop');
SELECT s.carrier, s.tracking_no, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at FROM Shipment s WHERE s.delivered_at IS NULL;
SELECT o.status, s.carrier, s.tracking_no FROM Shipment s JOIN CustOrder o ON OWNER(s) = REF(o) WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL;
SELECT p.promo_name, c.max_uses, c.per_user_limit FROM Coupon c JOIN Promotion p ON OWNER(c) = REF(p) WHERE c.max_uses > 0;
SELECT w.warehouse_name, b.code FROM WarehouseBin b JOIN Warehouse w ON OWNER(b) = REF(w) WHERE w.region = 'east';
SELECT s.supplier_name, sc.email, sc.phone FROM SupplierContact sc JOIN Supplier s ON OWNER(sc) = REF(s) WHERE sc.email IS NOT NULL;
SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name FROM category_products cp JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.is_active = 1;
SELECT p.product_name, t.tag_name FROM product_tags pt JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(pt, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Tag t ON ENDPOINT(pt, Tag) = REF(t) WHERE p.base_price > 50;
SELECT p.product_name AS bundle, c.product_name AS component FROM bundle_components bc JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(bc, product_id) = REF(p) JOIN Product c ON ENDPOINT(bc, bundle_product_id) = REF(c);

SELECT p1.product_name AS product, p2.product_name AS related_product FROM bought_together bt JOIN Product p1 ON ENDPOINT(bt, product_id) = REF(p1) JOIN Product p2 ON ENDPOINT(bt, bought_together_product_id) = REF(p2) WHERE p1.is_active = 1 AND p2.is_active = 1;
SELECT OWNER(c) AS customer_ref, p.product_name FROM cart_contains cc JOIN Cart c ON ENDPOINT(cc, Cart) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cc, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.quantity > 0;
SELECT w.wishlist_name, p.product_name FROM wishlist_contains wc JOIN Wishlist w ON ENDPOINT(wc, Wishlist) = REF(w) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(wc, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.base_price < 100;
SELECT p.product_name, r.rating, r.title FROM reviews rv JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(rv, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Review r ON ENDPOINT(rv, Review) = REF(r) WHERE r.rating >= 4;
SELECT c.email, o.placed_at, o.status FROM customer_orders co JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) WHERE o.status = 'placed';
SELECT o.status, p.product_name, p.base_price FROM order_items oi JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(oi, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(oi, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.quantity > 0;

SELECT pm.brand, pm.last4, o.status FROM payment_order po JOIN PaymentMethod pm ON ENDPOINT(po, PaymentMethod) = REF(pm) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(po, CustOrder) = REF(o) WHERE pm.is_default = 'true';
SELECT o.placed_at, p.product_name FROM order_returns r JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(r, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(r, Product) = REF(p) WHERE o.status = 'returned';
SELECT o.status, c.max_uses, c.per_user_limit FROM order_coupons oc JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(oc, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Coupon c ON ENDPOINT(oc, Coupon) = REF(c) WHERE c.per_user_limit > 0;
SELECT p.product_name, b.code FROM stock st JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(st, Product) = REF(p) JOIN WarehouseBin b ON ENDPOINT(st, WarehouseBin) = REF(b) WHERE p.quantity < 10;
SELECT s.supplier_name, p.product_name FROM supplier_products sp JOIN Supplier s ON ENDPOINT(sp, Supplier) = REF(s) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(sp, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.is_active = 1;

SELECT s.supplier_name, po.created_at, po.status FROM supplier_pos r JOIN Supplier s ON ENDPOINT(r, Supplier) = REF(s) JOIN PurchaseOrder po ON ENDPOINT(r, PurchaseOrder) = REF(po) WHERE po.status <> 'closed';
SELECT po.status, p.product_name FROM po_items pi JOIN PurchaseOrder po ON ENDPOINT(pi, PurchaseOrder) = REF(po) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(pi, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.base_price >= 100;

SELECT cp.carrier_code, s.tracking_no, s.delivered_at FROM courier_shipments cs JOIN CourierPartner cp ON ENDPOINT(cs, CourierPartner) = REF(cp) JOIN Shipment s ON ENDPOINT(cs, Shipment) = REF(s) WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p1.product_name AS phone, p2.product_name AS bundled_phone FROM bundle_phones bp JOIN Phone p1 ON ENDPOINT(bp, phone_id) = REF(p1) JOIN Phone p2 ON ENDPOINT(bp, bundle_phone_id) = REF(p2) WHERE p1.carrier_lock = 'unlocked';

SELECT p.product_name AS phone, a.product_name AS accessory FROM bundled_phone_accessory bpa JOIN Phone p ON ENDPOINT(bpa, Phone) = REF(p) JOIN Accessory a ON ENDPOINT(bpa, Accessory) = REF(a) WHERE a.base_price < 75;
SELECT s.product_name, c.email FROM software_downloads sd JOIN Software s ON ENDPOINT(sd, Software) = REF(s) JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(sd, Customer) = REF(c) WHERE s.is_active = 1;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS product_count FROM category_products cp JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(c), c.category_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) >= 2;

SELECT t.tag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS product_count FROM product_tags pt JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(pt, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Tag t ON ENDPOINT(pt, Tag) = REF(t) GROUP BY REF(t), t.tag_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) > 5;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.base_price) AS average_price, MAX(p.base_price) AS maximum_price FROM category_products cp JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY REF(c), c.category_name HAVING AVG(p.base_price) > 50;

SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS supplied_products FROM supplier_products sp JOIN Supplier s ON ENDPOINT(sp, Supplier) = REF(s) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(sp, Product) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(s), s.supplier_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) >= 3;

SELECT w.warehouse_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS stocked_products FROM stock st JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(st, Product) = REF(p) JOIN WarehouseBin b ON ENDPOINT(st, WarehouseBin) = REF(b) JOIN Warehouse w ON OWNER(b) = REF(w) GROUP BY REF(w), w.warehouse_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) > 10;

SELECT c.email, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(o)) AS order_count FROM customer_orders co JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) GROUP BY REF(c), c.email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(o)) >= 2;

SELECT o.status, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS item_count, SUM(p.base_price) AS item_value FROM order_items oi JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(oi, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(oi, Product) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(o), o.status HAVING SUM(p.base_price) > 200;

SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(r)) AS review_count, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews rv JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(rv, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Review r ON ENDPOINT(rv, Review) = REF(r) GROUP BY REF(p), p.product_name HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 3;

SELECT OWNER(c) AS customer_ref, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS cart_products FROM cart_contains cc JOIN Cart c ON ENDPOINT(cc, Cart) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cc, Product) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(c), OWNER(c) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) >= 1;

SELECT w.wishlist_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS wishlist_products FROM wishlist_contains wc JOIN Wishlist w ON ENDPOINT(wc, Wishlist) = REF(w) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(wc, Product) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(w), w.wishlist_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) >= 2;

SELECT s.product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(c)) AS download_customers FROM software_downloads sd JOIN Software s ON ENDPOINT(sd, Software) = REF(s) JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(sd, Customer) = REF(c) GROUP BY REF(s), s.product_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(c)) > 10;

SELECT p.product_name, MIN(ph.price) AS minimum_price, MAX(ph.price) AS maximum_price, AVG(ph.price) AS average_price FROM PriceHistory ph JOIN Product p ON OWNER(ph) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(p), p.product_name HAVING MIN(ph.price) < MAX(ph.price);
SELECT c.email, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(r)) AS review_count, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating FROM Review r JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(r) = REF(c) GROUP BY REF(c), c.email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(r)) >= 2;

SELECT p.promo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(c)) AS coupon_count, MAX(c.max_uses) AS largest_limit FROM Coupon c JOIN Promotion p ON OWNER(c) = REF(p) GROUP BY REF(p), p.promo_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(c)) > 1;

SELECT cp.carrier_code, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(s)) AS shipment_count FROM courier_shipments cs JOIN CourierPartner cp ON ENDPOINT(cs, CourierPartner) = REF(cp) JOIN Shipment s ON ENDPOINT(cs, Shipment) = REF(s) GROUP BY REF(cp), cp.carrier_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(s)) >= 5;

SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name, t.tag_name FROM category_products cp JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) JOIN product_tags pt ON ENDPOINT(pt, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Tag t ON ENDPOINT(pt, Tag) = REF(t) WHERE p.is_active = 1;

SELECT s.supplier_name, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM supplier_products sp JOIN Supplier s ON ENDPOINT(sp, Supplier) = REF(s) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(sp, Product) = REF(p) JOIN category_products cp ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) WHERE p.base_price > 100;

SELECT p.product_name, r.rating, r.title, c.email FROM reviews rv JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(rv, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Review r ON ENDPOINT(rv, Review) = REF(r) JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(r) = REF(c) WHERE r.rating >= 4;

SELECT c.email, o.status, p.product_name FROM customer_orders co JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN order_items oi ON ENDPOINT(oi, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(oi, Product) = REF(p) WHERE o.status = 'placed';

SELECT c.email, o.status, pm.brand, pm.last4 FROM customer_orders co JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN payment_order po ON ENDPOINT(po, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN PaymentMethod pm ON ENDPOINT(po, PaymentMethod) = REF(pm) WHERE pm.is_default = 'true';

SELECT o.status, p.promo_name, c.max_uses FROM order_coupons oc JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(oc, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Coupon c ON ENDPOINT(oc, Coupon) = REF(c) JOIN Promotion p ON OWNER(c) = REF(p) WHERE p.discount_value IS NOT NULL;

SELECT w.warehouse_name, b.code, p.product_name, c.category_name FROM stock st JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(st, Product) = REF(p) JOIN WarehouseBin b ON ENDPOINT(st, WarehouseBin) = REF(b) JOIN Warehouse w ON OWNER(b) = REF(w) JOIN category_products cp ON ENDPOINT(cp, Product) = REF(p) JOIN Category c ON ENDPOINT(cp, Category) = REF(c) WHERE w.region = 'west';

SELECT s.supplier_name, po.status, p.product_name FROM supplier_pos sp JOIN Supplier s ON ENDPOINT(sp, Supplier) = REF(s) JOIN PurchaseOrder po ON ENDPOINT(sp, PurchaseOrder) = REF(po) JOIN po_items pi ON ENDPOINT(pi, PurchaseOrder) = REF(po) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(pi, Product) = REF(p) WHERE po.status = 'open';

SELECT cp.carrier_code, s.tracking_no, o.status FROM courier_shipments cs JOIN CourierPartner cp ON ENDPOINT(cs, CourierPartner) = REF(cp) JOIN Shipment s ON ENDPOINT(cs, Shipment) = REF(s) JOIN CustOrder o ON OWNER(s) = REF(o) WHERE s.delivered_at IS NULL;

SELECT p.product_name AS phone, a.product_name AS accessory, ph.price FROM bundled_phone_accessory bpa JOIN Phone p ON ENDPOINT(bpa, Phone) = REF(p) JOIN Accessory a ON ENDPOINT(bpa, Accessory) = REF(a) JOIN PriceHistory ph ON OWNER(ph) = REF(a) WHERE ph.price < a.base_price;

SELECT c.email, s.product_name, o.status FROM software_downloads sd JOIN Software s ON ENDPOINT(sd, Software) = REF(s) JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(sd, Customer) = REF(c) LEFT JOIN customer_orders co ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) LEFT JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) WHERE s.is_active = 1;

SELECT p.product_name AS bundle, c.product_name AS component, t.tag_name FROM bundle_components bc JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(bc, product_id) = REF(p) JOIN Product c ON ENDPOINT(bc, bundle_product_id) = REF(c) JOIN product_tags pt ON ENDPOINT(pt, Product) = REF(c) JOIN Tag t ON ENDPOINT(pt, Tag) = REF(t) WHERE c.is_active = 1;

SELECT p1.product_name, c1.category_name, p2.product_name, c2.category_name FROM bought_together bt JOIN Product p1 ON ENDPOINT(bt, product_id) = REF(p1) JOIN Product p2 ON ENDPOINT(bt, bought_together_product_id) = REF(p2) JOIN category_products cp1 ON ENDPOINT(cp1, Product) = REF(p1) JOIN Category c1 ON ENDPOINT(cp1, Category) = REF(c1) JOIN category_products cp2 ON ENDPOINT(cp2, Product) = REF(p2) JOIN Category c2 ON ENDPOINT(cp2, Category) = REF(c2);

SELECT c.email, cart.updated_at, p.product_name, pv.barcode FROM Cart cart JOIN Customer c ON OWNER(cart) = REF(c) JOIN cart_contains cc ON ENDPOINT(cc, Cart) = REF(cart) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(cc, Product) = REF(p) LEFT JOIN ProductVariant pv ON OWNER(pv) = REF(p) WHERE p.quantity > 0;

SELECT c.email, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(o)) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT REF(p)) AS product_count, AVG(p.base_price) AS average_product_price FROM customer_orders co JOIN Customer c ON ENDPOINT(co, Customer) = REF(c) JOIN CustOrder o ON ENDPOINT(co, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN order_items oi ON ENDPOINT(oi, CustOrder) = REF(o) JOIN Product p ON ENDPOINT(oi, Product) = REF(p) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY REF(c), c.email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT REF(o)) >= 2 AND AVG(p.base_price) > 50;
